title: Azeron per-game planning workbook — version 2
description: Inert planning data. Structure cannot prove semantics, input support, ergonomics or authorization. Check stable ID references, priority arithmetic, source versions and scopes separately.

shared_baseline_snapshot.description: Reported user baseline, not current native bytes. Retain source identity and explicit coverage when replacing with a newer accepted snapshot.

$comment: P=4*(U-1)+F, higher=greater need. If a dimension is completely unknown, use an empty candidate list and computed_priority=null; score_candidates empty until bounded. Do not silently manufacture confidence. Override requires a scoped accepted rule. Unknown required features are read-only.
